# Paris City Tours

> > Your complete guide to Paris attractions and tours, featuring Eiffel Tower tickets, Seine River cruises, Louvre Museum access, and iconic landmarks across France's capital.

Paris City Tours offers booking services for Paris's most popular attractions including the Eiffel Tower, Versailles Palace, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Musée d'Orsay, and Rodin Museum. The site specializes in Seine River cruises, hop-on hop-off bus tours, and skip-the-line tickets to major landmarks with options for audio guides and combination packages.

## Key Topics

- Eiffel Tower tickets and summit access
- Seine River cruises and boat tours
- Louvre Museum entry
- Versailles Palace tours
- Notre-Dame Cathedral visits
- Musée d'Orsay impressionist art
- Paris landmarks and sightseeing
- Hop-on hop-off bus tours
- Gothic architecture
- French history and royal tombs
- Self-guided audio tours
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Montmartre and Arc de Triomphe
- Bateaux Mouches cruises
- Mobile vouchers and booking confirmation

## Iconic Landmarks & Museums

- [Paris: Eiffel Tower Tickets with Summit Access](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-eiffel-tower-tickets-with-summit-access-1): Eiffel Tower summit access tickets with elevator to all floors
- [Paris Eiffel Tower Entry Tickets](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/attraction/paris-eiffel-tower-entry-tickets-25): Eiffel Tower entry tickets collection page with summit & cruise options
- [Versailles Palace](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/attraction/versailles-palace-6): Versailles Palace tours with Hall of Mirrors & royal apartments access
- [Paris: Orsay Museum Entry Ticket](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-orsay-museum-entry-ticket-664): Orsay Museum ticket for Monet, Van Gogh & Renoir impressionist art
- [Notre-Dame Cathedral Entry with Host Assistance](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/notre-dame-cathedral-entry-with-host-assistance-843): Notre-Dame Cathedral entry with host assistance & Seine cruise option
- [Paris: The Rodin Museum and Digital Audio Guide App](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-the-rodin-museum-and-digital-audio-guide-app-806): Rodin Museum ticket with audio guide for The Thinker & The Kiss sculptures

## Seine River Cruises

- [Paris: Seine River Cruise by Bateaux Mouches](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-seine-river-cruise-by-bateaux-mouches-847): Bateaux Mouches Seine cruise past Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame & Louvre
- [Paris: Seine River Cruise Tickets By Night](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-seine-river-cruise-tickets-by-night-63): Night Seine River cruise with illuminated Eiffel Tower & Louvre views
- [Paris: Day or Sunset Cruise with Drink, Ice Cream or Dessert](https://www.pariscitytours.fr/paris/paris-day-or-sunset-cruise-with-drink-ice-cream-or-dessert-669): Seine sunset cruise with drinks from Eiffel Tower to Notre-Dame & Louvre
